_comment: Curated contacts the app shows without any network lookup. Neel owns this file. Every entry was checked by hand on the service's own site or an official government page on the date in verified_on. Re-check before the demo and before 15 Dec. Hours and contact are copied from the source, not paraphrased.

helplines.name: Nummer gegen Kummer – Kinder- und Jugendtelefon
helplines.notes: Free and anonymous, by phone. The same site also offers a text chat Mon–Thu 14–20.

helplines.name: krisenchat
helplines.notes: Free chat counselling (web or WhatsApp) for everyone under 25. No chatbots, according to the service. A Ukrainian page exists at krisenchat.de/uk.

emergency.name: Polizei (Notruf)
emergency.notes: Free from any phone, without an area code.

emergency.name: Feuerwehr und Rettungsdienst (Notruf)
emergency.notes: Free, works across Europe, landline or mobile.
